title: Cognition Care - A novel approach detecting mild cognitive impairment (MCI) by evaluating of a structured diagnostic algorithm in primary care settings
summary: The primary outcome measure is the number of newly diagnosed persons with MCI within a 12-month observation period in participating GPs (i.e., incidence). This outcome will be assessed through anonymized data extraction from the respective practice software systems.

interventions.name: Patients in study arm 1 pursue a routine diagnostic procedure.
